editorial:
Imagine moving back to your tiny, salty fishing town in Maine to deal with your mother's death, only to find a dead body in your house. That is exactly what happens to the Connolly sisters. You get to follow these sisters as they try to hide the body to avoid getting in trouble, which accidentally pulls them into a world of local crime and secrets. The vibe is a weird but fun mix of a sad family drama and a dark comedy. It feels like a rainy day in a coastal town where everyone knows everyone, but nobody is actually telling the truth.

What really makes this work is the acting; the sisters feel like real people who are just winging it. The plot has some great twists that keep you guessing, though the middle part slows down a bit. If you enjoy stories about family secrets and small-town mysteries, you will love this. It is a solid choice for a weekend movie night with friends.
endingExplained: At the end, you find out the dead man was actually involved in a huge local theft. The sisters eventually figure out who the real bad guys are in their town. After a tense standoff, they manage to outsmart the criminals and clear their names. They get the money and finally find a way to move past their grief, leaving the town with a new sense of strength and a secret they will keep forever.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves quirky family dramas and crime mysteries.
